P1.established: Input is a list of lowercase string tags; output is a single team name string.

P2.established: Tags 'account', 'billing', 'privacy' map to teams of the same name when appearing alone; input order and duplicate count do not affect the result for single-tag inputs.

P3.established: Inputs may contain overlapping team tags and unknown tags; classification must follow established conventions.

H1.established: When multiple known team tags exist, select the first one in the order: 'privacy', 'billing', 'account'.

H2.established: When unknown tags are mixed with known team tags, ignore the unknown tags and apply the priority rule to the known tags.

H3.established: If 'billing', 'account', and 'privacy' are all present, route to 'privacy'.

H4.established: If only 'account' and 'billing' are present (overlap), route to 'billing'.
